narration.text: [whispers] Control, this is Post Three. Someone is running in the corridor. [long pause] [softly] The Castle of Good Hope. Cape Town. The oldest colonial building in South Africa. [long pause] I walk it alone. Two till dawn. [long pause] The guards before me said, you'll hear footsteps. And when you stop... they take two more. [long pause] Seventeen twenty-nine. Governor van Noodt sentenced seven soldiers to hang. One of them, the story goes, cursed him from the gallows. [long pause] The same day, the governor was found dead, in his chair. History says it was his heart. [long pause] Guards have reported a tall man, leaning over the battlements. [long pause] And a woman in grey, running through the corridors. [long pause] When they dug here, they found the remains of a woman. No one knows who she was. [long pause] [whispers] Control, Post Three. Dungeon's clear. I'm coming up.
